data_description.model: The WD5 series includes OWD5 and MWD5; the WG4 series includes UWG4, AWG4 and Warm Tiles ESW. Select Migrate existing Warm Tiles to reuse an existing account in Home Assistant.

data_description.api_key: The API key used by the app.
data_description.host: Leave blank to use the default. If specified, omit the https://.
data_description.customer_id: Leave blank to use the default.

data_description.host: Leave blank to use the default. If specified, omit the https://.
data_description.application: The application code sent on login. Standard WG4 thermostats use 2; Danfoss LX uses 4; Warm Tiles ESW (warmtiles.mythermostat.info) uses 13.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for this thermostat account. Your existing cloud settings and devices will be preserved.

legacy.title: Migrate existing Warm Tiles
legacy.description: Disable your existing Warm Tiles integration, then select its account to add it to OJ Microline. Credentials stay in Home Assistant. Thermostat settings are preserved.

error.timeout: A timeout occurred, please try again

abort.invalid_legacy_entry: The selected legacy Warm Tiles integration could not be imported.
abort.invalid_auth: The account credentials could not be authenticated.
abort.timeout: The thermostat cloud timed out. The legacy integration was not changed.
abort.connection_failed: The thermostat cloud could not be reached. The legacy integration was not changed.
abort.unknown: The thermostat cloud returned an unexpected error. The legacy integration was not changed.
abort.legacy_not_disabled: Disable the existing Warm Tiles integration before migrating, so only one integration can control these thermostats.

init.description: Set default options when changing the thermostat temperature.

data.comfort_mode_duration: The duration in minutes the comfort mode should be enabled.

data_description.use_comfort_mode: Allow the comfort preset and use it for temperature changes while following a schedule. Existing manual or comfort mode is preserved.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Schedule a vacation for the thermostat's group (WD5 series). The vacation runs from 00:00 on the start date until 00:00 on the end date; if it has already started, vacation mode is activated immediately.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day of the vacation.

cancel_vacation.name: Cancel vacation
cancel_vacation.description: Cancel the scheduled or active vacation for the thermostat's group (WD5 series). An active vacation returns to schedule or manual mode, whichever was used last.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set the events of one or more weekdays in the thermostat group's weekly schedule (WD5 series). Up to 6 events per day, on the quarter hour, at least 15 minutes apart; a time earlier than the previous one is after midnight (03:00 at the latest).

events.name: Events
events.description: The day's events in order, each with a time (HH:MM) and a temperature (5-40 °C).

set_native_schedule.name: Edit native weekly schedule
set_native_schedule.description: Preview or save WG4 weekly event patches on one thermostat. Times use the thermostat local clock. Saving preserves the current preset. A response is required; preview defaults to true.

changes.name: Event changes
changes.description: Patches with day (monday through sunday), slot (0 through 5), and optional time (HH:MM), temperature or active. Unspecified fields and events are preserved.

expected_hash.name: Original schedule hash
expected_hash.description: The full schedule_hash from the native schedule sensor when editing began. A newer app/device edit causes the save to be rejected.

temperature_unit.name: Temperature unit
temperature_unit.description: C for Celsius or F for Fahrenheit. Nested temperatures are interpreted explicitly in this unit.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: True validates cached data without cloud requests. False reads fresh data, saves a backup, uploads once and checks cloud readback.
